title: Bowman Team Members Named to GVF’s 2026 Top TDM Professionals Under 40
summary: Bowman transportation team members Danielle Derolf, Aaron Real and Zakary Ruppert named to GVF’s 2026 Top TDM Professionals Under 40 list.
body_markdown:
Three members of Bowman’s transportation team have been named to[GVF’s 2026 Top TDM Professionals Under 40 list](https://www.gvftma.com/post/gvf-recognizes-2026-s-top-tdm-professionals-under-40) :


- **Danielle Derolf, PE, assistant project manager**
- **Aaron Real, engineer III, transportation**
- **Zakary T. Ruppert, PE, project manager**


The annual recognition celebrates professionals making an impact on the transportation industry and helping advance transportation demand management (TDM) throughout the region.


The three Bowman honorees were recognized alongside 43 other transportation professionals as part of the 2026 class. For more than 35 years, GVF has worked to expand mobility options across southeastern Pennsylvania, bringing together transportation and infrastructure professionals committed to improving mobility throughout the region. Now in its 13th year, the Top TDM Professionals Under 40 program highlights the next generation of leaders contributing to those efforts.


Danielle, Aaron and Zak’s inclusion in this year’s class marks an exciting achievement for each of them and a proud moment for Bowman’s transportation team.
